column3: 对话内容
des
Stranded here, even greenhorns dare to look down on us... Today you won't leave alive!
...Don't blame my cruelty, times are truly hard. This quiet spot will make a good burial ground after dealing with you!
The boss's orders - rob all passersby of both wealth and life!
The wild wolf drools greedily, its vertical pupils glaring fiercely at you...
We'll take both your possessions and life as capital for our return to the underworld! If you die here, blame your ill fate and bad luck!
The boss's orders - rob all passersby of both wealth and life!
Traveler... might you lend me the silver you carry?
Hand over all valuables - money, cloth, trinkets! I'm in a hurry. Say no and I'll silence you forever!
You... you recognize me! Since you've seen my face, I can't let you live!
Oh ho! Someone dares enter this territory... Since you came willingly, you know what comes next!
Boat thieves without boats... Hmm? A volunteer! Fine, I'll kill you and take your money to start a business!
Waiting here for our boss, we get this fat sheep delivered to us! Such luck can't be missed!
Traveler, that's a big bag... I'll just take your bundle as interest. The rest I'll leave for your life - hand it over now!
Don't recognize you... Not from the village? How dare you not pay respects to me! Need a lesson!
Heard someone new came to village without paying tribute... Must be you! Let's see what you're made of!
The trained wolf drools greedily, its vertical pupils glaring fiercely at you...
Village idlers, so self-important... We've been here with Minister Right for days, bored to death. Stay longer and we'll use you for entertainment!
Want to live? Hand over your money now!
The wolf pack charges at you, teeth bared for blood...
Since you've seen our faces, we can't let you report to authorities!
Poisonous snakes coil before you - clearly dangerous ground...
You stumble into a thieves' den, instantly surrounded by bandits...
What blind fool dares intrude here?
Since you've come, don't think of leaving!
My hands itch from years without killing... Youngster, since you bumped into me, let's test your skills!
You seem extraordinary - let me learn from you!
Enter my alley, and I'll teach you the local rules!
Though East Market's gone, Cheng'an Town still belongs to us!
Come, let me show you the Ximen family martial arts!
The wild wolves drool greedily, their vertical pupils glaring fiercely at you...
R-r-robbery! H-hand over your silver!
Oh ho! Enter my turf without paying tribute?
The blue heaven dies, the yellow heaven rises!
Walking here, you sense bloody aura behind you...
...Didn't expect company here. Don't blame me.
Since you've seen me, you can't leave alive!
Gold! Women! Mine!
Scram! Don't ruin my fun!
Morning dew vanishes, warriors die... Who's worthy to test my blade?
Get lost! Don't interfere with our business!
Another scholar from Horizon Pavilion sent you? Die!
Hehe, treasure acquired...
Amitabha... Earthly suffering ends here - let this monk release you.
You there! Saw what happened? Then you're not leaving!
Hangzhou's lovely scenery... After traveling with my wife, we'll settle here...
None of your business! Don't ask for a beating!
Sigh... Age weakens these fists, not like the old days.
Han man, stay! Leave your goods!
No livelihood in this world - might as well take others down with us!
Han people, how dare you trespass our sacred grounds!
Walking here, you hear wolves howling behind...
A crimson viper blocks your path...
Stumbling into a nest of gu insects, venomous snakes surround you...
From rotting gu flowers emerges a man moving like a centipede - spotting you, he attacks!
Several mindless gu centipede slaves charge at you...
Entering, shadowy figures surround you...
Entering, shadowy figures surround you...
Han people? Get lost!
Entering, shadowy figures surround you...
Entering, shadowy figures surround you...
Entering, shadowy figures surround you...
A Taoist greets you, then attacks when you return courtesy...
We garrison soldiers need drinking money - hand it over!
Fierce bandits armed with blades and tools - clearly dangerous.
Green-eyed hungry wolves lurk here, their alpha baring fangs at you.
...Leave if you value your life.
Gaunt starving men prowl with knives, eyeing prey.
You look broke. Scram! Don't block our robbery!
Damn! Another blind fool...
Fierce Jurchen warriors camp here, their leader massive and formidable.
Jurchen scouts ride about arrogantly.
Central Plains Han! Get lost!
I advise you - leave quickly!
Savage bandits eye you murderously.
Jurchen spies lurk, watching all directions.
Boisterous Jurchen warriors drink and carouse here.
Tense Jurchen warriors grip weapons tightly.
What's murder and arson? Even the government can't touch us beyond the pass!
Jurchen soldiers hide here in disarray - likely remnants defeated by Banner Sect.
Emperor rules inland, but here I'm king!
Green-eyed hungry wolves lurk here, their alpha baring fangs at you.
A massive tiger prowls the woods, growling at your approach.
What you looking at? Scram!
In Luoyang, no one's beyond my reach!
Merchants who don't pay "protection money" won't do business here!
Dead men keep secrets best - even Buddha couldn't make them talk.
Village dissenters get sent to Yama for judgment!
Heard Luoyang's full of philanthropists - I'll make them donate till bankrupt!
Westerners pay high prices for Buddha heads - who knew rocks were valuable?
Just smuggling out a few artifacts means lifetime wealth!
Without our temple's prayer certificates, Buddha won't hear your prayers!
The capital's paved with gold... One day...
With black market closed, where shall my brothers earn their keep...
You! Lend me some silver!
Government troops? Hah! I once killed a whole shipful myself!
Know what rank my master holds? You're unworthy to speak to me! Get lost!
I rule these waterways!
Our water bandits span lakes and seas - even without headquarters, we endure!
Eunuch Li gave us new life - we'll repay with loyalty. Who cares who's emperor?
To Central Plains we raid, returning with full loads!
The world killed my lord... Pity I can't personally avenge him!
Dying for our lord is our honor!
Even lone samurai die when they meet us!
Hah! Koreans are weaklings - killing them isn't even fun.
Back in Central Plains, my crimes warranted nine familial exterminations!
Kill... kill...
Blood feeds the blade, kill... kill...
Blood feeds the blade, kill... kill...
